Package model

Class Chat

java.lang.Object
utils.Observable<Event>
model.Chat
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Chat extends Observable<Event> implements Serializable
Chat class This class is responsible for managing the chat. It contains the list of messages sent and the list of active users. It extends the Observable class. It notifies the observers when a message is sent or a user connects/disconnects. The observers are anonymous classes that are created in the lobby each time a new user connects.
